name: toast
title: Toast
description: UI SDK toasts: ToastStack renders a styled, announced region with a tone icon per type; toast() and createToaster() add toasts with actions, cancel and timed dismissal.
docs: Place `<ToastStack />` once. Its close buttons are named `Dismiss`: pass `labels={{ close: "…" }}` in the page's language. Each type shows a decorative icon in its tone colour (a spinner while loading, none for `default`); the text still has to say what happened. Only the toasts take pointer events, and timers pause on focus or a pointer resting `hoverDelay` ms (300). In tests, find toasts with `[data-slot="toast"]` or `@eskais/test-utils`, not page-wide text: UI SDK copies each toast into a live region that outlives it.
